title: Review of c02's FCH chemoton (SIBE): on fresh seed 5 bodies form from noise, but no vesicle carries the catalyst (it sits on one open strip) and the starvation fork shrinks every body to a micelle without killing any
summary: Re-ran world.py and world_starve.py unchanged on fresh seed 5 (192^2, T=600). Bilayer strips, worms and one ring form from noise by t~50 and persist (S, I). The catalyst K survives on only one body, an open bilayer strip with K beaded at its ends; the closed vesicle that forms at t~450 carries no K (max K 0.08-0.12 vs 5.7 on the strip; bodies_seed5.txt, channels_seed5.png). Six K-free bodies keep a near-constant size from t=300 to 600 in the fed run, so persistence does not need a body's own catalyst. With the feed cut at t=300 every body shrinks (u total 2298 -> 323 vs 1984 in the fed twin) to micelle-sized dots of about 82 px, the K-bearing one included, but all 7 are still present at t=600.

observations.S: rerun/fed_s5/sheet.png t=0 uniform noise, bodies by t=24-51
observations.I: rerun/fed_s5/sheet.png: 7 discrete bilayer bodies persist t=150-600 at bounded size (bodies_seed5.txt)

seeds_run.result: partial: S and I reproduce; no K-carrying vesicle forms (K only on one open strip), so the claimed individual (a vesicle with a K layer) is absent; starvation fork shrinks all bodies, none dies by t=600

controls_run.E: rerun/starve_s5 (feed cut at t=300) vs rerun/fed_s5: population decline only, 7/7 bodies alive at t=600 (shrunk to ~82 px); K-free bodies persist as long as the K-bearing one in both arms

by_construction: E (amphiphile is made only by K from P and decays)
verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed. B: the K layer on a closed bilayer is not reproduced on seed 5, which behaves like the author's seed 1 (K on an open strip, K-free rings fed through the shared bath). E: the rubric's fork test asks that individuals die, not shrink; here starvation turns every body, catalytic or not, into a micelle, and K-free bodies are as persistent as the catalytic one, so dependence of an individual on its own metabolism is not shown. A longer starved run (t>600) might show the micelles vanish.
